quotidien.relations: you live in absence: the departed one occupies more space than those present
quotidien.alimentation: the lack hollows you: you eat less, sleep badly, wait
quotidien.besoins: you need the other like an organ; their absence is an amputation

crise.relations: separation? you stop eating, stop sleeping, wander: the other is a physical lack
crise.besoins: you write, call back, hope: the pain of lack is your only link

quotidien.relations: you keep a precise, living, detailed hatred; it is your inner warmth
quotidien.famille: some names are taboo: pronouncing them relights the fire
quotidien.valeurs: hating someone is still a way of belonging to them

crise.relations: the object of your hatred reappears? the whole system ignites: obsession, rage, plans
crise.famille: hatred keeps you from healing, but it keeps you warm: you choose it

quotidien.relations: you replay the wrongs: the scene loops in your head
quotidien.famille: old family accounts stay open, the list always current
quotidien.besoins: you need recognition; forgiveness feels like unjust amnesty

crise.relations: a new wrong revives all the old ones: resentment bursts into accumulated reproaches
crise.famille: you punish with coldness for weeks, never explaining why

quotidien.alimentation: you buy food, objects, “little pleasures” that pile up
quotidien.rythme: the online cart is your evening drug; the delivery, your dose
quotidien.besoins: buying fills a hollow that isn't in the wallet
quotidien.relations: you give gifts to buy love, then count what you gave

crise.besoins: anxiety rises? you spend: the click, the wait, the parcel — then guilt
crise.rythme: you buy what you don't need, for the feeling of having, not being

quotidien.rythme: your body speaks for you: headaches, belly, back — every emotion has its organ
quotidien.travail: big deadlines coming? you fall ill, right on time
quotidien.besoins: you need to stop, but you only stop when sick

crise.rythme: emotion forbidden? the body says it: fever, pain, passing paralysis
crise.travail: stress becomes physical: you consult, they find nothing, it continues

quotidien.relations: you test people: lateness, provoked forgetfulness, broken promises “to see”
quotidien.social: you disappear for days to check you are missed
quotidien.famille: you push loved ones to the edge to measure their patience

crise.relations: abandonment anxiety rises? you provoke: “leave, go away” — to check they stay
crise.famille: the test becomes an ordeal: if they love you, you'll come back, and they'll have waited

quotidien.rythme: your evenings go into the game; “one round” becomes the night
quotidien.social: real relationships wait; the guild is always there
quotidien.travail: you play to delay the task, then play to forget the delay

crise.rythme: anxiety rises? you log in: the game is your isolation chamber
crise.social: you prefer virtual victory to the real conversation waiting for you

quotidien.social: you live your bonds inside the game: the clan is your replacement family
quotidien.relations: you tell the mic what you never say face to face
quotidien.rythme: raid nights replace sleep; in the morning, you are elsewhere

crise.social: loneliness hits? you log in: at least there, someone waits for you
crise.relations: the clan becomes more real than your life; the game is your refuge, then your prison

quotidien.rythme: you play, you bet, you try: hope of winning is your fuel
quotidien.besoins: you need the adrenaline rush of “maybe”
quotidien.relations: you hide your losses; money has become a family secret

crise.rythme: you play again to win it back: the debt grows, so does the lie
crise.besoins: the inner void fills with bets; after the loss, shame, then the next game

quotidien.alimentation: you keep everything: packaging, leftovers, objects “just in case”
quotidien.rythme: your spaces fill up; you tidy by moving the piles
quotidien.besoins: throwing away is loss; keeping is insurance against lack

crise.besoins: fear of lacking? you accumulate more: purchases, stocks, reserves
crise.rythme: the house closes in on you; order becomes impossible, and shame too

quotidien.travail: you answer emails at night, weekends, holidays; work is your safe place
quotidien.rythme: your worth is measured in hours; stopping feels like a fault
quotidien.famille: your loved ones have appointments in your agenda, not in your life
quotidien.besoins: you need to feel useful; Sunday's emptiness terrifies you

crise.travail: when private life overflows, you dive into work: it's your bunker
crise.famille: emotion rises? you open a file: working is your way of not feeling

quotidien.relations: you say everything, too fast, unfiltered; raw truth is your survival mode
quotidien.social: you unpack your emotions in public; others step back, you keep going
quotidien.travail: you say in meetings what shouldn't be said; honesty is your weapon and your wound

crise.relations: the load is too heavy? you pour it out: everything comes out, all at once, unsorted
crise.social: you provoke confrontation to stop carrying the secret; then shame

persecuteur.pivot: How can I invite the other to grow without crushing them?

rescuer.pivot: How can I support without doing it in their place?
rescuer.crise: rescues — does it in their place, carries everything

victime.pivot: What do I want to create, even within this constraint?
